items.quote: And the angel of the LORD called unto Abraham out of heaven the second time
items.claim: The text says the angel of the LORD called to Abraham from heaven a second time.

items.quote: By myself have I sworn, saith the LORD, for because thou hast done this thing, and hast not withheld thy son, thine only son
items.claim: The LORD swears an oath by himself, and the stated reason is that Abraham did not withhold his only son.
items.mechanism: oath given because Abraham did not withhold his only son

items.quote: in multiplying I will multiply thy seed as the stars of the heaven, and as the sand which is upon the sea shore
items.claim: God promises to bless Abraham and give him as many descendants as the stars in the sky and the sand on the seashore.
items.mechanism: divine blessing as a reward for obedience

items.quote: thy seed shall possess the gate of his enemies
items.claim: God promises that Abraham's descendants will take possession of their enemies' gates.

items.quote: And in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed; because thou hast obeyed my voice.
items.claim: God promises that all nations of the earth will be blessed through Abraham's descendants, and the stated reason is Abraham's obedience.
items.object: all the nations of the earth
